EV-000003

Third autocorrelation constant, signed f, absolute value outside the maximum · Autocorrelation inequalities · status current

Definition

For real (signed) f supported on [-1/4,1/4] with nonzero integral, the ratio |max_t (f*f)(t)| / (int f)^2, minimised over f; this is the quantity scored by the public benchmark validators. Entries record the best upper bound.

C_3=\inf_{f:\ \operatorname{supp}f\subseteq[-\frac14,\frac14]}\frac{\left|\max_t (f*f)(t)\right|}{(\int f)^2}

Domain: real-valued functions on [-1/4,1/4]. Normalisation: dimensionless ratio. Direction: min.

Conflation note

Often confused with the variant that takes the absolute value INSIDE the maximum, max_t |(f*f)(t)|. Example: the 2025 results notebook labels 1.4557 as C3 and 1.4688 as C3'; the later v2 paper labels the 1.4688 problem 6.4(a) (unprimed) and the 1.4557 problem 6.4'. Values from one variant do not bound the other. See the max-of-absolute-value entry.
